description: Greater Mekong Subregion hydropower dams is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. A dataset containing known operational and planned hydropower dams in the Greater Mekong Subregion compiled by International Rivers and published in June 2014. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Electricity infrastructure, Electricity production, Environment and natural resources, Fishing fisheries and aquaculture, Water resources. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, geojson, kml. The portal shows 2018-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
